options.counterfactual: Strictness does not persist under increasing rank: for some n≥4 and c≥3, γ_c(IA_n)∩A_{c+1}(n)=γ_{c+1}(IA_n), even though strictness holds in rank three.
options.approach: Audit the higher-rank Alexander representation and determinant-balancing construction. Check whether these actually produce a homomorphism into the claimed central extension, since losing that homomorphism would invalidate the uniform rank argument.

options.approach: Study the rank-three witnesses after adjoining one fixed free generator. Compute their images in nilpotent quotients of IA_4 to determine whether stabilization kills their lower-central classes.

options.approach: Audit the integral relation-lattice certificates rather than their rational ranks. Compute Smith normal forms and verify that every claimed lattice generator comes from an actual relation among IA automorphisms.
